title: bug: verified-local task under deliveryPolicy legacy skips every required check
description: Repro: delivery/policy.ts evaluateDeliveryEvidence returns {satisfied:true} as soon as resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy gives 'legacy'. That happens before the CQ-V04 strong rule (trustedPassedOn, required-checks-undeclared) runs. So a verified-local task in a project with no deliveryPolicy, or with an explicit 'legacy', passes qa_approve and dependency readiness with no trusted check evidence at all. It is latent while assertExecutionProfileReady throws. Decide one fix: either require a strict deliveryPolicy whenever the profile is verified-local (settings validation or snapshot capture), or judge checks for verified-local even under legacy. Found in CQ-V04's adversarial review.
definitionOfDone: A verified-local task can never be judged satisfied without trusted required-check evidence, whatever deliveryPolicy is set
Legacy and observe verdicts unchanged; regression test covers verified-local + legacy/absent deliveryPolicy
